title: Seoul Metropolitan Government press release — 15 March 2026 Seoul Marathon section traffic control
claims: The 15 March 2026 course runs Gwanghwamun Square → Sungnyemun → Cheonggyecheon → Dongdaemun Design Plaza → Seoul Children's Grand Park → Seoul Forest → Jamsil Sports Complex.
The general sections' representative control window is 07:20–12:55; main sections are controlled sequentially from 05:00 to 14:30 and released flexibly once runners have passed.

Medical personnel with an ambulance and AED are stationed every 2.5 km; a race patrol carries emergency kits; about 4,800 safety staff and volunteers are deployed, with a joint operation headquarters and medical booths.

The 2026 start time was moved 30 minutes earlier than the previous year and traffic release was also moved 30 minutes earlier, following the 2026 marathon guideline; the secretariat is 02-312-1998 and the 120 Dasan call centre.
The city asks citizens to use public transport near the start and finish.
